scope: Workspace profile lifecycle: locally generated IDs remain unique across editor reloads when Date.now() repeats.

finding.before: Profile save/import used profile-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${pageLocalSequence}. The sequence restarts on each Editor mount and the candidate was not checked against already stored profiles. A same-millisecond retry after reload could duplicate an existing ID; normalization keeps the first duplicate and silently drops the later profile on restore.
finding.fix: Both save and import use nextWorkspaceProfileId(), which advances the local sequence until the candidate is absent from the current allowlisted profile set. The versioned profile schema and localStorage contract are unchanged.
finding.page_model_save_publish: No Page Model, Save, or Publish contract changed. The Chromium test asserts that profile save/import makes zero page-write requests.

verification.pre_fix_logic: A saved ID ending in -1 plus a newly mounted Editor with sequence 0 and the same fixed clock produces the same -1 candidate under the previous formula; the regression fixture fixes the clock and stores that prior ID.
